title: Binary Search Tree: Find Minimum and Maximum
summary: The smallest value in a binary search tree is its leftmost node and the largest is its rightmost node: just keep walking one way.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Values to insert (in order)
inputs.note: At least one value. They are inserted into a binary search tree first.

practice.note: The tree arrives as `root` (None or null when empty), built by inserting the values one at a time into a binary search tree (smaller goes left, equal or larger goes right). A TreeNode has `val`, `left` and `right`. Return a list with two values: the smallest, then the largest.
